budget_note: Trevor set $150/day account-wide (raised from an initial $100/day). Prior run rate was ~$157/day, so this is roughly flat rather than a cut -- PMax is funded by the increase instead of by starving proven performers.
keyword_source: Google Ads Keyword Planner API (KeywordPlanIdeaService), US / English, pulled live. No invented terms.

campaigns.name: BP · Outdoor Kitchens — SKAG
campaigns.rationale: Rebuilds the ONLY campaign in the account that converts (Build Your Own Outdoor Kitchen: 11 conv, $120 CPA). Highest-value category and the clearest buyer intent.

skags.note: Highest purchase intent in the entire dataset -- 'near me' plus category

campaigns.name: BP · Grills by Brand — SKAG
campaigns.rationale: Brand terms carry lower CPCs than category terms and higher purchase intent -- someone searching a specific brand has already chosen. Limited to 5 SKAGs so each gets enough budget to gather data.

skags.note: Best volume-to-cost ratio of any brand term
QUALIFIED deliberately -- bare 'coyote grill' pulls restaurant traffic
Highest bid range in the set -- expensive but signals high order value

campaigns.name: BP · Shopping — Brand/Model
campaigns.rationale: Shopping is how ecommerce sells, but the three existing Shopping campaigns burned $1,686/mo for zero recorded conversions. Restarting as ONE measured tier instead of three, at a fraction of prior spend, until it proves itself.
campaigns.note: Single tier deliberately. The generic/brand/model ladder gets rebuilt only once this one demonstrates it converts.

campaigns.name: BP RT · Display Remarketing
campaigns.rationale: RETAINED, not rebuilt. Existing BP RT 2 delivers the best CPA in the account -- 7 conversions at $21 on just $147/mo. It was budget-starved at $5/day; this is a modest increase.

campaigns.name: BP · PMax — Brand Clusters
campaigns.rationale: Trevor's chosen PMax + SKAG hybrid. Four asset groups clustered by category. Full asset spec in build_specs/betterpatio_pmax.json.

pmax_decision.note: Included at Trevor's explicit direction after being advised that PMax optimizes toward a conversion signal this account does not currently record. Created paused; confirm the purchase pixel fires before enabling.

required_negatives.note: Campaign-level negatives beyond the shared universal list, driven by what the keyword data exposed.

BP \u00b7 Grills by Brand \u2014 SKAG.reason: Restaurant chain surfacing in grill searches

excluded_from_build.reason: Their single largest wasted line item -- $199 spend, 43 clicks, zero conversions. At 60,500/mo and $2.11-7.16 CPC it would dominate the $70/day allocated to Search and crowd out the terms that actually convert. Still excluded at $150/day; revisit once conversion tracking works and the SKAGs have proven their CPA.
